headline.purpose: Page-level titles inside a tool or section.

title.purpose: Card-level titles: auth headings, tool-card names.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, nav links.

shadows.name: ambient-card-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts raised auth-style cards off the page without looking heavy.

shadows.name: primary-action-glow
shadows.purpose: Exclusively on the primary gradient button, tinted with the accent color.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen — gradient blue fill with a tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #1786f9, #5eb0ff); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(23 134 249 / 0.3); transition: filter 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #eaf4ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for non-primary actions (e.g. Download PNG).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #10151c; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e7ec; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f7f9fb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #eaf4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input used across auth forms and tool inputs.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #10151c; border: 1px solid #e2e7ec; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1786f9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #eaf4ff; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised container for auth panels and tool content.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #edf1f4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Tool Card (link)
components.description: Homepage grid item linking to a tool; icon badge, name, description.
components.html: ▦QR Code GeneratorTurn text, links, or WiFi credentials into a QR code.
components.css: .ds-tool-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #edf1f4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-tool-card:hover { border-color: #1786f9; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -4px rgb(23 134 249 / 0.1); } .ds-tool-card__icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: #eaf4ff; color: #0f6cd1; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-tool-card__name { font-weight: 700; color: #10151c; } .ds-tool-card:hover .ds-tool-card__name { color: #0f6cd1; } .ds-tool-card__desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #5b6672; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-segmented__item { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; background: #f7f9fb; color: #5b6672; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-segmented__item:hover { color: #10151c; } .ds-segmented__item--active { background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #1786f9, #5eb0ff); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky top bar with the Sky Tools logo image and auth-aware nav links.
components.html: ToolsSign up
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e7ec; } .ds-nav__logo-img { display: block; height: 28px; width: auto; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__links a { color: #5b6672; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: #10151c; } .ds-nav__cta { background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #1786f9, #5eb0ff); color: #ffffff !important; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview: Sky Tools looks like a well-organized workshop, not a storefront. Every surface exists to help someone finish a task in seconds — generate a code, download it, move on — so the interface stays plain, sturdy, and confident through restraint rather than decoration. A single calm, trustworthy blue, sampled directly from the Sky Tools logo mark, is the only color the system spends deliberately; everything else is white space, soft neutral cards, and legible type doing the actual work. This is a utility identity, not a marketing one. It explicitly rejects the glossy SaaS-landing-page register (no big gradient hero sections, no glassmorphism, no illustration-heavy pitch energy) and the opposite failure mode of a dense enterprise dashboard (no cramped data tables, no wall-to-wall controls). As more tools join the registry, each one should feel like it was carved from the same quiet toolbench, not bolted on.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, single-accent blue used sparingly against a near-white neutral field
Flat-leaning, restrained elevation — shadows separate, they don't decorate
Generous whitespace even as more tools and more UI are added
Quietly refined component detailing (smooth radii, considered gradients) rather than bare-framework defaults

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue in the system. Any new tool that needs a second signal color (success, warning) should reach for the neutral scale plus the existing red before introducing a new hue — Sky Tools does not accumulate a rainbow of per-tool accents.

rules.name: The No-Second-Typeface Rule
rules.body: Every future tool uses Geist Sans for UI text. A tool that displays user data verbatim may use Geist Mono for that data only — never for labels, buttons, or headings.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: At most one element per screen carries the tinted 'primary action' shadow. If a screen has no single primary action, no element gets it.

dos: Do keep blue as the system's only hue; reach for the neutral or red scale before introducing a new color.
Do use the gradient + tinted shadow combination only for the single primary action on a screen.
Do keep body and label text on Geist Sans; reserve Geist Mono strictly for verbatim data/code display in future tools.
Do keep forms single-column and vertically stacked, regardless of how many fields a new tool needs.
donts: Don't introduce glassmorphism, large gradient hero sections, or illustration-heavy marketing composition — Sky Tools is a toolbench, not a landing page.
Don't build dense, data-table-heavy dashboard layouts — keep spacing generous even as more saved items or tools accumulate.
Don't add a second accent color for a new tool's 'brand' — every tool shares the one blue identity.
Don't use heavy neutral drop shadows; if a surface needs to lift, use the ambient card-lift value or the accent-tinted primary-action shadow, never a generic dark shadow.
Don't recreate the logo as coded text/SVG — it's a fixed raster asset (public/logo-lockup.png).
